task_summary: Write a Suricata rule (sid:1000001) in /root/local.rules that detects HTTP POST exfiltration matching specific path, header, and body patterns while avoiding false positives.
decomposition_rationale: This is a focused task requiring one skill: writing a correct Suricata 7.0 rule with sticky buffers, exact URI matching, header inspection, and PCRE body matching. The background research provides all needed syntax details. A single skill covering Suricata rule construction is sufficient since there's no separate data processing or output formatting needed.

skills.name: evo-suricata-http-exfil-rule
skills.description: Constructs and validates Suricata 7.0 rules for detecting HTTP-based data exfiltration patterns using sticky buffers, content matching, and PCRE. Covers HTTP method, URI exact matching, request header inspection, and request body pattern matching with url_decode transform.
skills.responsibility: Generate the correct Suricata rule syntax for /root/local.rules that matches HTTP POST to exact path /telemetry/v2/report with X-TLM-Mode: exfil header, base64 blob≥80 chars, and sig= with exactly 64 hex chars. Includes knowledge of sticky buffer ordering, http.method, http.uri with startswith/endswith, http.request_header with colon-space delimiter, http.request_body with url_decode transform, and PCRE boundary anchoring.
dr_sections: Understanding Sticky Buffers and Rule Scoping
The Importance of Transforms in Modern Rule Writing
1. Suricata 7.0.x HTTP Rule Keywords: Exact Syntax and Semantics
2. PCRE in Suricata Rules: Syntax for Body Matching
3. Combining Multiple Match Conditions in a Single Rule
